scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace apps/server & npm run dev --workspace apps/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run build --workspace apps/client
scripts.build:pages: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace apps/server && node scripts/generate-static-catalog.mjs && VITE_DEPLOY_TARGET=github-pages npm run build --workspace apps/client && cp apps/client/dist/index.html apps/client/dist/404.html
